description: This PHP source file defines the OrganizationDao class, which manages database operations related to Organization entities in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for retrieving general organization information, saving organization data, and updating organization structures.

classes.name: OrganizationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling operations related to Organization entities, including retrieval, saving, and updating organization information.

methods.name: getOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Retrieves the general Information for the Organization, returns an Organization object or null if not found.

methods.name: saveOrganizationGeneralInformation
methods.description: Saves the provided Organization object to the database, handling transaction management and exception handling.

methods.name: updateOrganizationStructure
methods.description: Updates the organization structure by setting the name of the base Subunit to match the Organization's name.
